answers.explanation: The network interface card, or an equivalent chip on the motherboard.
The NIC's controller does the link layer and its physical part drives the medium. Layers 3 and up run in software on the CPU.
It's a combination of hardware, software, and firmware, and most of the work happens on the NIC itself.
Encapsulation at layer 2: header in front, error-checking trailer behind.
De-encapsulation: strip the layer 2 header and trailer, hand the datagram up.
The host's system bus, such as PCI or PCIe.
A hub doesn't read frames at all. Switches replaced hubs because they forward each frame only where it needs to go.
A virtual switch does in software what a physical switch does in hardware, for the VMs' virtual NICs.
